This is an implementation of volumetric spot noise, a technique for representing three dimensional textures algorithmically using small kernels. This work is largely based on the method presented by Nicolas Pavie et al. in the paper Volumetric Spot Noise for Procedural 3D Shell Texture Synthesis with several modifications.
